# Bootstrap Buttons Three — Research & Tasks

- **Source**: ColorLib Bootstrap Buttons 03 (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/bootstrap-buttons-03/)
- **New Name**: `bootstrap-buttons-three`
- **Category**: UI Component Library / Buttons

## Section Breakdown

1. **Header / Navbar**: Branding title, category navigation links, theme toggle.
2. **Hero Showcase**: Introduction to solid & outline button variations.
3. **Solid Buttons Grid**: Primary, secondary, success, danger, warning, info fills with hover lift.
4. **Outline Buttons Grid**: Clean bordered buttons with background fill on hover.
5. **Interactive States & Sizes**: Small, medium, large, disabled, loading spinner buttons.
6. **Code Snippet Drawer**: Interactive markup inspector with copy-to-clipboard.
7. **Footer**: Component Dock attribution link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).
